selection_rule: Among points passing every integrity, quality, I/O, significance, and ceiling gate, select the lowest treatment p95 latency; break ties by p50 latency, backing reads, backing bytes, transient peak bytes, then larger mean recall. The 200 ms p95 is rejection-only and never sufficient for selection.
evidence_boundary: Full checksum-pinned Cohere Medium 1M corpus and all 1,000 shipped test queries/ground-truth rows. Each control/treatment pair uses identical search settings, independent readers, alternating arm order, and reset disk cache. Synthetic or inserted-ID recall is ineligible. Incomplete JSONL is never inspected; evaluation requires the terminal completion marker and no failure marker. This local arm cannot support AWS, 100M, modality-parity, or competitor claims.
